item.title: Transform Job Descriptions Into Interview Questions 💼 • Identify key skills and duties in the job post. • Create questions based on these skills. • Use: “Can you describe your experience with X?” • Prepare answers highlighting relevant achievements. • Practice articulating your responses clearly. How can you convert job duties into specific interview questions? #interview #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
